scope.summary: Implement StudioEffectStack, the single canonical layer-effects/styles primitive, with non-destructive, re-editable, re-orderable, independently maskable effects: Bevel & Emboss (style/technique/depth/direction/size/soften/angle/altitude/gloss-contour + contour & texture sub-effects), Stroke (color/gradient/pattern at outside/inside/center), Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Satin, Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay, Pattern Overlay, Outer Glow, Drop Shadow (angle/distance/spread-choke/size/contour/noise/knockout). Provide a document-wide shareable Global Light angle, a contour/gloss-contour editor, saveable reusable styles (StudioStyleRegistry entries), and effects copyable/pasteable/scalable/hideable/removable/convertible-to-pixel-layers.
acceptance_criteria: all 10 effect types non-destructive, re-orderable, independently maskable
Global Light shareable; styles saveable/pasteable/scalable; effect->pixel-layer convert
proof_targets: effect-stack + saved-style paste + global-light runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: add Drop Shadow + Stroke + Bevel to a layer, reorder them, mask one, and save the combination as a reusable style; paste the style onto another layer
live: Global Light angle change updates all shadow/bevel effects; convert an effect to a standalone pixel layer

risk_if_missed: No layer styles; shadows/glows/strokes/overlays and reusable styles absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
